label: sec:quantum-brings
html:
The quantum deformation of the commutator relations on Bring's surface is described here in outline. The classical commutator [e_a, e_b] = \epsilon_{abc}\,e_c on \mathfrak{su}(2) is replaced by the q-deformed commutator from U_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)). Bring's defining equations \sum x_j = \sum x_j^2 = \sum x_j^3 = 0 are interpreted as relations on the q-symmetric algebra of the substrate parameter q(p). This formalism relates the non-commutative geometry of the deformed surface directly to the substrate parameter, recovering the classical Bring surface in the limit q \to 1.

The details are not developed here; this section fixes only the structural scope of the deformation.
